Stōbi , ōrum, m.,
I.an ancient and important city of Paeonia in Northern Macedonia, Liv. 33, 19, 3 Weissenb. ad loc.; 39, 53, 15; “40, 21, 1: oppidum Stobi civium Romanorum,” Plin. 4, 10, 17, § 34 .—The inhabitants are called Stōbenses , ĭum, m., Dig. 50, 15, 8, § 8.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
